title: Klelund Halifax Memorial
memorial_details: Memorial stone in the forest at the crash site, Klelund Plantation, Hovborg, Syddanmark.
narrative: Halifax LK705 of 431 (RCAF) Squadron, coded SE-X, departed Croft at 2027 on 25 February 1944 on a gardening (minelaying) operation. The aircraft was intercepted at 5600m near Aastrup by Leutnant Erich Lippert of 10/NJG3 and shot down at 2343, his first claim. The aircraft crashed approximately 10km north of Holsted. All seven crew were killed.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Lt Erich Lippert (10/NJG3), his 1st claim
